LESSON: CHRISTIAN RITUALS RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CHRISTIAN
Topic 3.3: Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when praying?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Role play the giving of offerings as a ritual in church
2. Demonstrate Chrstian rituals associated with prayer to improve his/her prayer life
3. Appreciate taking part in Christian rituals for example 168 giving offerings and praying for his/her spiritual nourishment. praying and giving offerings in the church

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Role play the giving of offerings as a ritual in church
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to role play the giving of offerings as a ritual in church. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Demonstrate Chrstian rituals associated with prayer to improve his/her prayer life
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate Chrstian rituals associated with prayer to improve his/her prayer life. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate taking part in Christian rituals for example 168 giving offerings and praying for his/her spiritual nourishment. praying and giving offerings in the church
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate taking part in Christian rituals for example 168 giving offerings and praying for his/her spiritual nourishment. praying and giving offerings in the church. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND.
2. Explain Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND.
4. Show that you can: Role play the giving of offerings as a ritual in church
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when praying?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Role play the giving of offerings as a ritual in church
2. Demonstrate Chrstian rituals associated with prayer to improve his/her prayer life
3. Appreciate taking part in Christian rituals for example 168 giving offerings and praying for his/her spiritual nourishment. praying and giving offerings in the church
